headline: Arcturus Defense Seizes Geartown South — 'Stabilization' or Occupation?
body: Arcturus Defense forces moved into Geartown South at 0340 this morning, deploying an estimated 1,200 combat personnel and fourteen Warden-class autonomous enforcement platforms against the semi-autonomous industrial enclave formerly administered by the Ferrogate Transit Authority. The operation, codenamed IRON COVENANT, was over in under four hours. Ferrogate's sixteen-person security detail was detained without reported casualties, though residents describe a different picture. 'They came through the ventilation corridors first,' said Mako Delacroix-Wu, a shift worker at the Helyx Foundry on Sub-Level 4. 'By the time anyone saw lights in the street, it was already done.' Arcturus released a statement citing 'persistent governance failures and unpaid infrastructure debt totaling 890,000 quanta' as justification for the acquisition, a claim Ferrogate Transit's board publicly denied before its emergency comms channel went dark at 0712. The Federal Remnant's Office of Territorial Integrity issued a formal protest by midday — its third unanswered protest to Arcturus this decade.
aftermath: Ferrogate Transit filed a sovereignty challenge with the Meridian Commerce Tribunal, but Arcturus had already begun rebranding Geartown South manufacturing facilities under its FORGE division within 72 hours of the incursion.
runner_relevance: The seizure created immediate demand for extraction contracts — Ferrogate middle management and engineers with proprietary transit-mapping data became high-value targets for both Arcturus (wanting them silenced or recruited) and rival corponations (wanting their knowledge). Bore Rats and independent couriers found a surge in smuggling work moving displaced Ferrogate loyalists and contraband equipment out through the underground before Arcturus locked down the perimeter. Protection contracts for Ferrogate-aligned small businesses in the district spiked to between 4,000–9,000 quanta per week.
